text:
maria: Heads-up: eu-west racks showing sudden NVMe resets and GPU evictions after the OOB BMC image at 01:47Z. Pod churn started ~02:00Z.

infra-oncall: Confirmed. r14-01..r14-03 showed repeated "nvme0: controller reset" and PCIe retrain logs. Marking rollout PAUSED.

deploy-bot: rollout "bmc-2026-03-21" status: PAUSED by infra-oncall at 02:10Z

ops-ethan: Running quick revert on r14-01 to previous signed image. Command:
```
ssh jump-r14
sudo bmc-fw-tool flash --image s3://fw/bmc-2026-02-09-signed.bin --rack r14-01 --reboot
watch -n 5 bmc-health --rack r14-01
```

aisha: Add preflight: check `bmcctl ntp-status` and `lspci -vv | grep AER` before any rack apply. Also enable extended PCIe telemetry for next canary.

sre-robin: Triage note: the new image toggled a secure-boot enforcement bit during activation on some BMCs; the activation sequence does a bus re-enumeration that on certain board revisions causes lane retrain. That retrain triggers NVMe controller resets.

maria: Can we hold autoscaler and increase kubelet eviction grace to 12m for the affected node-pool to reduce reschedule storms?

infra-oncall: Done: kubelet eviction grace bumped and autoscaler scale-in paused for eu-west inference pools.

ops-ethan: Revert finished on r14-01; initial 20m smoke shows no PCIe retrains. Running fio + 10m GPU burn to validate.

finance-liz: FYI: holding pools and extended canaries will add ~110 GPU-hours if this lasts 24h. I've alerted budget owners.

maria: Postmortem owners: jonathan + aisha. Immediate actions: pause rollout (done), revert affected racks (in progress), autoscaler hold (done), finance notified (done). Will update #incidents with customer impact in 30m. :thumbsup:
